products.name: APM-Flex
products.generic: a passenger security processing system for airlines

evidence.quote: The implementation of the APM-Flex system across all Delta locations underscores our commitment to ensuring a seamless and secure travel experience for all passengers.
Over 700 units deployed in 32 airports servicing over 90% of all US bound traffic from Europe
Used by the UK Home Office as part of the E-borders scheme and currently connects with over 30 Governmental APIS schemes
It has been tested and certified by several intenational and EU regulators and is now fully operational at a number of airports and seaports.
